title: Rainbow cycles in triangle-free graphs
summary: Let $G = (V,E)$ be an edge-colored graph, and let $δ^c(G) = \min_{v \in V} \{ d^{c}(v) \}$ where $d^c(v)$ is the number of colors on edges incident to a vertex $v$. We show that for a sufficiently large $n$ if $G$ is an edge-colored triangle-free graph of order $n$ that satisfies $δ^c(G)\geq (n+7)/5$, then $G$ contains a rainbow cycle of length four, which improves a bound of Ding et al. and is best possible.
